description: Source code implementing a pseudo-random number generator based on timing and system events, with functions for generating raw true random numbers.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer for generating timing-based randomness.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Handles timer interrupts to measure timing variations.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects timing data and produces a pseudo-random number based on system clock skew.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Generates a raw true random number by calling roulette multiple times.
